description: This file defines the EventSequenceToken class, which is a specialized implementation of StreamSequenceToken used for tracking event batches within a stream, including sequence number and event index, with serialization support.

classes.name: EventSequenceToken
classes.description: A serializable class representing a sequence token for events in a stream, including sequence number and event index, used for stream processing in Orleans.

methods.name: CreateSequenceTokenForEvent
methods.description: Creates a new EventSequenceToken for a specific event index within the current batch.

methods.name: Equals (object)
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, overridden from base.

methods.name: Equals (StreamSequenceToken)
methods.description: Checks equality with another stream sequence token.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this token with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on SequenceNumber and EventIndex.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.
